name: UpwindImageScan
description: Scan a container image with Upwind ShiftLeft and comment the results on the pull request
helpMarkDown: Scans a container image for vulnerabilities, secrets and malware with Upwind ShiftLeft. On pull request builds the results are posted as a sticky comment thread. Grant the project build service identity 'Contribute to pull requests' on the repository to enable the comment.
author: Upwind

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Image
inputs.helpMarkDown: Image to scan, for example myapp:$(Build.SourceVersion).

inputs.name: clientSecret
inputs.label: Upwind client secret
inputs.helpMarkDown: Upwind ShiftLeft credential client secret. Pass a secret pipeline variable, for example $(UPWIND_CLIENT_SECRET).

inputs.name: blockOn
inputs.label: Block on
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the task when the image verdict reaches this level.

inputs.name: enforceBlockPolicy
inputs.label: Enforce organization block policy
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the task when the organization's Upwind PR block policy blocks the image.

inputs.name: dockerPull
inputs.label: Pull image
inputs.helpMarkDown: Pull the image before scanning. Disable when the image was built earlier in this pipeline.

inputs.name: postComment
inputs.label: Post PR comment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Post the scan results as a comment thread on pull request builds.
